description.narrative: For the project to be deemed successful the following will have been achieved • Reaching 5718 individuals with cash based transfer for at least 3 months • Target households have improved knowledge and practices regarding optimal nutritional, gender-sensitive and hygienic behaviour.• Improved capacity of government agencies and other stakeholders for better coordination, project effectiveness and sustainability of Early Action Protocols• Improved short term food and nutrition support for food insecure households• Reduced risk of abuse, exploitation, and violence (GBV) for vulnerable target groups• Improved climate smart livelihoods and income generating opportunities• Improved enabling environment to enable communities to better respond to economic and climate shocks

In scope of the FbA Programme, the proposed project intends to address the expected drought impacts using cash-based transfer, and livelihood initiatives. Cash Based transfer which will target 30% (953 households) of the 3177 vulnerable households in the selected wards. The resilience and livelihood initiatives includes the distribution of project starter packs for communities and trainings on small livestock farming, gender sensitive agriculture, financial literacy, and marketing skills
